text: On a farm, young Francisca learns from her mother, a trained surgeon, how to take the eyes from farm animals. When [a door-to-door salesman asks to use the bathroom|trigger|an outsider reaches in] and kills her mother in the tub, her father [chains him in the barn|images|ropes, cages and executions], and the girl decides he will be her only friend. Years later, alone in the farmhouse with her father's preserved body, the grown Francisca goes looking for company in bars and on the highway, [hungry for someone to love|wants|to be loved and belong], and [a baby to call her own|wants|a child to take or have].
